sections.content:
The game is over. I notice that Node 29 (the HUD bar) now has 64 pixels and is all G (green), spanning the entire bottom row. This is different from before when it had G pixels on the left and c pixels on the right. This suggests the game over state changes the HUD bar.
Also, I notice the red crosses are GONE from the segmentation output. Let me check if they're still there but as 1-pixel nodes that I filtered out.
Looking at the segmentation, I don't see any r (red) color nodes. The red crosses that were at (10, 52) and (52, 10) are gone. This is a significant change!
Also, the green source body (Node 2) now has 14 pixels, which is much more than the 5 pixels when consumed. This suggests the green source is now FULL (or even more than full).
Wait, but the game is over. The red crosses disappearing might be the "game over" indicator.
Let me think about what happened:
1. I clicked left-green (consume green)
2. I clicked right-green (restore green)
3. I clicked top-yellow (consume yellow) → GAME OVER
The game ended after the 3rd click. The red crosses disappeared. This suggests that clicking the top-yellow C-shape was the wrong move.
But wait, the game is over and I can't continue. I need to figure out how to restart or if there's a way to continue.
Actually, looking more carefully at the segmentation, I see that the red cross pixels are gone. But the game says `game_over: true`. Maybe I need to click something to restart the level?
Let me try clicking one of the C-shapes to see if the game restarts. If the game is truly over, maybe clicking anything will restart it.
Actually, wait. Let me re-read the instructions. It says "The game is over." and `game_over: true`. But `done: false`. This is confusing. Maybe the game is over but I can still take actions?
Let me try clicking the bottom-yellow C-shape to see if the game restarts or if something happens.
